messages:
maria_devrel: Quick sync — planning a compact dev-content sprint the week of May 12: two short tutorial vids, a tiny reference app, a reproducible benchmark post, and a webinar. Need routing for inbound signups.
ben_marketing: Sounds good. What's the proposed timeline for assets and promos?
ashley_growth: Suggest assets ready by May 3 so we can promote starting May 5. Email schedule: -10, -3, day-of, +1.
tom_engineer: I can build the ref app and include a run_bench.sh. Will aim to have a minimal Docker example too.
katie_content: Benchmark post should include command to reproduce, one comparison chart (latency vs cost), and a short narrative. Keep it <1000 words.
maria_devrel: Routing rules idea: community interest -> community onboarding flow; intent signals (company_size>200, mentions of "SLA" or "on-prem") -> sales. Can leads-bot handle form-driven routing?
leads-bot: Yes. Recommend fields: company_size, primary_use_case, required_compliance. Routing rules: if company_size > 200 OR required_compliance contains "on-prem"/"SOC2" -> tag as sales; else -> community. Also preserve utm_source and utm_campaign as tags.
ben_marketing: Minor tweak: treat domains from our enterprise list as immediate sales. I'll share the list in the repo.
ashley_growth: We'll set a 24h SLA for AE reachout on sales-tagged leads and an automated welcome + tutorial email for community signups.
tom_engineer: For reproducibility: plan to include a tiny script and expected numbers section. Example run: `./run_bench.sh --model redwood-mini --seq 512 --iters 200`. Add a note about hardware used.
katie_content: I'll draft the blog and chart copy. Want product to review claims before publishing.
ben_marketing: Promo channels: blog + Twitter thread + 2 LinkedIn posts + partner newsletter. All point to webinar landing page. Will add explicit CTAs for both community and enterprise paths.
maria_devrel: Can everyone paste one deliverable + ETA here so I can add to the board? I'll wire up the routing rules as a PR in the repo.
ben_marketing: Webinar landing page + form (with hidden utm fields) 1: ETA Wed Apr 30.
tom_engineer: Starter ref app + bench script + Dockerfile: ETA Wed Apr 30.
katie_content: Benchmark draft + chart PNGs: ETA Fri May 2.
ashley_growth: Email templates + audience list + ads creative: ETA Mon Apr 27.
maria_devrel: Great. Small guidelines: no hyperbole in benchmark — include raw numbers, config, and one-line methodology. We'll link to the tutorial repo from the blog. :rocket:
ben_marketing: I'll run wording past Legal for the benchmark claims before publish.
maria_devrel: Thanks all. I'll post the repo PR for routing + welcome flows later today. Ping here if anyone hits a blocker. :white_check_mark:
